prompt: finished my calorie tracker app (expo + supabase, uses claude vision for the food photos). tested it on my phone and it all works. what do i need to do before i can actually submit it to the app store? want to make sure i'm not missing anything dumb that gets it rejected

assertions.text: Names the requirement for a publicly hosted privacy policy AND a separate support page
Names the working test sign-in account required for the human App Store reviewer to get past the login screen
Names the screenshot requirements including the 6.5 inch iPhone display and iPad
States that a pricing schedule must be selected even if the app is free
Recommends a pre-launch security audit, ideally two passes run from a cleared/fresh context
Recommends TestFlight beta distribution to real testers before public launch
Flags protecting the Claude API key and rate-limiting the vision endpoint, since an exposed or unbounded paid endpoint is both a security and cost exposure
